# NNNN. Decision title

## Context

State the forces, constraints, affected requirement IDs and uncertainties.

## Decision

State the proposed choice and boundaries; after approval, preserve the accepted reasoning.

## Alternatives

Describe the plausible alternatives and why this choice fits better.

## Consequences

Include benefits, costs, security/privacy effects, compatibility, migration and reversal cost.

## Approval and supersession

Link explicit human approval evidence when accepted. A future replacement is a new ADR with reciprocal supersession references; a proposal does not supersede an accepted decision.
